Diane Vernesoni Topsham LD 373
I am writing to you today to urge you vehemently vote OUGHT NOT TO PASS on LD373, An Act to establish "Welcome Home" as the Official State Anthem. Having been born in Maine to a Founding Father family and lived here all my life, I think our present anthem speaks more to what Maine is about than the song "Welcome Home." This song, frankly, left me in a quandary of how they could connect it in any way to Maine. I may have gotten the wrong version, but it did nothing to make me feel it was from Maine or about Maine. Please be sure yu listen to this song before you make a decision. Not everything needs to be "FIXED." It's nice to have new things but they should fulfill their purpose and this, in my estimation, does not! Again, I urge you to vote OUGHT NOT TO PASS on LD 373. Thank you!

LD 373 - An Act to Establish "Welcome Home" as the Official State Anthem

Good morning, Senator Baldacci, Representative Salisbury and distinguished members of the Joint Standing Committee on State and Local Government. l'm
here to introduce LD372 - An Act to Establish "WeIcome Home" as the Ofiicial
State Anthem.

My name is Marianne Moore. I proudly represent Senate District 6 which
includes all of Washington County and 16 Communities in Eastern Hancock County as well.

During the summer of 2023, Gordon Thomas Ward reached out to me and shared his song "WeIcome Home" , a song all about Maine, that had just been released. He asked me to help champion " Welcome Home" to be considered the
Maine State Anthem.

Knowing l really couldn't introduce this bill during the second session of the 131"

Legislature since this type of matter was not really an "emergency";

once re-

elected, I turned this bill in as one of my first for the 132"" Legislature for your

consideration.

I am reminded an Anthem is defined as "a rousing or uplifting song identified with
a particular group, body, or cause." That's us - Mainersl

Research tells us Maine has four musical pieces adopted by the state of Maine.

1. The "State of Maine" was adopted as the State Song in 1937. It was written
and composed by Roger Vinton Snow, who died in 1953. This piece,
although it has lyrics, has a "march" tempo, and while it's a strong piece of music, it sounds quite dated.

2. In 2012, "The Dirigo March" was unanimously approved by the Maine State
Legislature as the Official State March. Leo J. Pepin, an Augusta native,
composed this march, a musical score with no lyrics, in 1961. 3. More recently, The Ghost of Paul Revere folk band had their ballad "The
Ballad of the 20th Maine" confirmed as the official State Ballad on June 7, 2019. The ballad focuses on the 20"` Maine Regiment's crucial role in winning the Battle of Gettysburg during the Civil War. Again, the ballad is excellent but does not address the present day.
4. in 2021, the legislature adopted Terry Swett's "My Sweet Maine" , which
was written to celebrate Maine's bicentennial in 2020, as the State Song of
the 21*` Century.
"Welcome Home" offers something different from the examples listed above. lt underscores a multitude of both historical and modern characteristics that make
our state appealing and recognized by others as special and unique. There are mentions of what Mainers and tourists see as valuable and precious, even mentioning that Mainers are "the hardest workin' folks you'll ever know." There's
definitely room for " Welcome Home" in Maine as a state anthem.

Did you know that Tennessee has twelve official state songs, the most in the
country, and an official bicentennial rap?

When you hear the song, "WeIcome Home" , you will see how it is a positive song,
upbeat, catchy, acknowledges the Wabanaki heritage and history, and embraces
many locations, occupations, activities and groups of people. More of that is

needed in today's world!

lt even mentions the little--known behavior of rolling

the windows down when driving into Maine, which, apparently, is more common

than l realized.

Gordon Thomas Ward, the songwriter, will be performing the song for you to

hear.

I have attached the lyrics to his song for you to follow along!

Maine deserves to have its own State Anthem. l hope you will agree and support
this bill!

Thank you!
